questions.question: Which of the following device is commonly used to improve the power factor in anelectrical system?
questions.explanation: The unit says capacitors improve power factor. Static capacitors draw leading current.
explanationLines: The unit says capacitors improve power factor.
Static capacitors draw leading current.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Which of the following is a consequence of a low power factor in an electrical system?
questions.explanation: Low power factor causes more energy loss. It also reduces system efficiency.
explanationLines: Low power factor causes more energy loss.
It also reduces system efficiency.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Which joint is used for tapping electrical energy for service connections in overhead distribution lines?
questions.explanation: A T-joint connects a main cable to a secondary branch. It is used where a branch is taken from a main cable.
explanationLines: A T-joint connects a main cable to a secondary branch.
It is used where a branch is taken from a main cable.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Which component is typically found on a panel board to protect circuits from overcurrent?
questions.explanation: MCCB protects circuits from overload and faults. It is a circuit breaker used in industrial/commercial systems.
explanationLines: MCCB protects circuits from overload and faults.
It is a circuit breaker used in industrial/commercial systems.

questions.question: When capacitors are connected to the electrical system for power factor correction, theyare usually connected in

They neutralize the lagging reactive component.
